title: Constent crash RPG Maker MZ Macos 15.1 Beta (24B5024e)

posts.author: Crazya
posts.body:

Again, I have no idea if its just me as I haven't seen anyone else report it.
Thanks for reading.
Solution:
After several hours of troubleshooting, I discovered the solution was surprisingly simple. Here’s how I fixed it:
Issue:
RPG Maker MZ was failing to launch on macOS, showing errors related to SteamAPI and missing AppID
(To be honest, it got deleted when I did it the first time. It was shown in one of my errors... sigh. User error for not checking it again)
Solution:
1.
Create or Edit steam_appid.txt:
Create a new text file named steam_appid.txt in the game's leading directory.
2.
Add the AppID:
Inside this text file, write the AppID of RPG Maker MZ, which is 1096900. Save the file.
3.
Restart the Game:
Relaunch the game. It should now run correctly without the previous errors.
Summary:
The SteamAPI could not find the AppID, and adding the steam_appid.txt file with the correct ID resolved the problem. It’s a simple fix and... made a huge difference.
For the record, I launched it through Steam, and for some reason, the AppID was still the issue.
Thank you.
